task_description: Add a rep-entered 'Add-on Services' capability to the Send Quotation dialog: a two-column (Service Name + Amount) repeatable input with an 'Add more service' button and per-row removal, rendered as a new labeled table section inside the quotation email HTML (visible in Preview and sent email). Single branch off latest origin/main; INTEGRATIONS_ONLY so CI (tsc + build) validates.
